items.title: Injectives and K-injectives restrict from the big etale site to the small one
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The counted unit is the author's own lemma lemma-compare-injectives at source lines 799-820: for a morphism Y -> X of the big etale site, injectives of Ab((Spaces/X)_etale) restrict to injectives both on Y_etale and on X_etale, and the same holds for K-injective complexes, while the corresponding statements for modules fail. The author's proof at source lines 822-851 proves parts (1)(b) and (2)(b) formally from the fact that the restriction functor is a right adjoint of an exact functor (two cross-chapter pointers), then proves parts (1)(a) and (2)(a) in two independent ways: first by exhibiting i_f^{-1} as a right adjoint of the exact functor i_{f,!} (three cross-chapter pointers), and second by factoring i_f = i_Y o f_{big}, using that f_{big} is a localization and hence preserves injectives and K-injectives (two more pointers) and applying the already proved parts. It closes by referring to a counterexample for modules (a further pointer). All cited inputs are outside the chapter and each is declared as a tagged source pointer; the two independent proofs of the substantive parts are both reproduced.
